question: The glycerol released by lipolysis is the substrate of the enzyme:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Glycerol -> Substrate for glycerol kinase -> 80% CHAIN: Glycerol -> Converted to glycerol-3-phosphate -> Substrate for glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase -> 85% CHAIN: Glycerol -> Enters glycolysis pathway -> Metabolized by triose phosphate isomerase -> 75% CHAIN: Glycerol -> Converted to dihydroxyacetone phosphate -> Metabolized by glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase -> 80%
analysis: Glycerol released by lipolysis is converted to glycerol-3-phosphate by the enzyme glycerol kinase.
